roads.name: Highway 17
words: Properly twisty: 18 curves in 2.5 miles, about 7 a mile.
The curves flow straight into one another.
From 9,408 to 9,826 ft, with 520 ft of up and down along the way.
roads.ratingNote: Bars show where it sits among the region's roads; the numbers are each part's share of the rating. At the 55 mph limit its corners still ask for about 0.83 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace.

roads.name: Highway 160
words: Sweeping and steady: 20 curves in 4.1 miles.
The 1.9 miles at the north end are tamer.
The curves flow straight into one another.
From 8,118 to 9,560 ft, with 1,494 ft of up and down along the way.
roads.ratingNote: Bars show where it sits among the region's roads; the numbers are each part's share of the rating. At the 35 mph limit its corners still ask for about 0.38 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace.
